title: Talk to Miso

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Mate. Never thanked you for finding my sis. Or my name. So yeah. Thanks. Miso owes you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mate. Never thanked you for finding my sis. Or my name. So yeah. Thanks. Miso owes you.
Talk to me.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Nah. Don't sit right. I'm Miso now, down to the meats.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nah. Don't sit right. I'm Miso now, down to the meats.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Something wrong with your brain pan? Do I look like I carry congealed cow? I only sell the clag.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Something wrong with your brain pan? Do I look like I carry congealed cow? I only sell the clag.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: So you need something or what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you need something or what?

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Woah woah woah, keep your voice down. You want every hygiene 'spector in the LUZ over here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Woah woah woah, keep your voice down. You want every hygiene 'spector in the LUZ over here?

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Look, Reeker ain't just illegal. It... does things to you. Makes you see shit that never goes away.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, Reeker ain't just illegal. It... does things to you. Makes you see shit that never goes away.
You don't wanna know, man.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Yeah yeah. But only 'cos you found Miso's sis. Go ask Harmony. Didn't hear that from me though.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah yeah. But only 'cos you found Miso's sis. Go ask Harmony. Didn't hear that from me though.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Yeah yeah. Go ask Harmony. Didn't hear it from me though.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah yeah. Go ask Harmony. Didn't hear it from me though.
Well, now you have me ...
No, it's much worse!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Don't you want to be called 'Seth'?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't you want to be called 'Seth'?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Don't you want to be called 'Seth'?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Don't you want to be called 'Seth'?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm looking for some cheese...
I'm looking for Green Reeker.
Whatever you say.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, do you know where I can get some?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, do you know where I can get some?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Well, do you know where I can get some?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Well, do you know where I can get some?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you got a hookup, or...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you got a hookup, or...?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you got a hookup, or...?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you got a hookup, or...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds better anyway.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The cheese I need isn't sold in a supermarket.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The cheese I need isn't sold in a supermarket.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: The cheese I need isn't sold in a supermarket.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: The cheese I need isn't sold in a supermarket.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you know what we're not talking about.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you know what we're not talking about.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you know what we're not talking about.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you know what we're not talking about.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds great.
Trust me, I don't.
